name: qni-cli
description: Deterministic quantum circuit CLI and Pi skill for Qni CoResearcher
author: Yasuhito Takamiya <yasuhito@hey.com> (https://github.com/yasuhito)

scripts.check: npm run test:ts && npm run test:scripts && npm run cucumber && npm run smoke:package
scripts.cucumber: npm run build && cucumber-js --config cucumber-js.mjs --require "features/support/**/*.js" --require "features/step_definitions/**/*.js" --format progress "features/**/*.feature.md"
scripts.test:ts: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('tmp/typescript-tests', {recursive: true, force: true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test "tmp/typescript-tests/test/typescript/**/*.test.js"
